data.explanation: This letter confirms you have been given an apartment by your housing cooperative, starting 1 January 2027. Two copies of the usage agreement (Nutzungsvertrag) are enclosed – sign both and send one back by the deadline shown. If you miss it, the cooperative may reassign the apartment or delay your move-in, so act promptly; contact the cooperative if you need more time. If anything in the attached contract is unclear, it may help to review it carefully or get advice before signing.
